messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Increased 5xx rate for Private VPC ILBs affecting cross-region egress (eu-west1 -> us-central). Alerting from synthetic checks and backend error spikes. Graph: https://internals.example.com/alerts/2141590000 :rotating_light:
oncall-anshul: I'm paged, looking. Starting live triage — pulling control plane traces and healthchecks. Can someone confirm customer impact?
emma: Observability shows a big spike in control-plane 503/429 responses from GCP's internal API starting ~2141589400. Also seeing a correlated surge of egress from our observability agent to the collector (high connection churn).
kyle: Confirmed. ILB control plane logs show repeated route update failures on the regional control endpoint. Sample: ```ERROR controlplane.go:312 updateRoutes: received 503 from /compute/v1/projects/redwood/regions/eu-west1/forwardingRules```
oncall-anshul: Good catch. Two hypotheses: 1) GCP regional control plane degraded (rate-limited) causing route propagation failures, or 2) our observability agents are creating a token/connection storm that amplifies control plane egress, triggering throttles. Both could be true.
emma: Datapoints — datadog shows outbound connections from observability agent spiked 6x, many with 401 retries. That could lead to retries hitting control plane/metadata endpoints.
maria: Paging the GCP support channel now (case 130244). Also opening a ticket with our observability vendor (ops-bot: creating vendor incident)
ops-bot: created vendor-ticket-553 with NimbusOps: Observability agent heartbeat & token refresh errors. Link: https://vendors.nimbusops/incident/553 :gear:

kyle: Quick mitigation options: (A) disable observability agent egress for Private VPCs temporarily via rollout (config flag), (B) add client-side backoff to agent to reduce retries, (C) force route failover to regional-local paths. We should pick immediate action to reduce control-plane load.
oncall-anshul: Priority: reduce load now. Emma, can you coordinate a config toggle for the agent? Simone, please prepare a routing fallback if needed.
emma: I can push a remote-config to turn off agent metrics/trace upload for Private VPCs in eu-west1. Will do a canary in 2 mins. Command: ```curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/v1/flags -d '{"agent.upload.enabled":false,"scope":"private-vpc:eu-west1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **'```
kyle: Also prepped gcloud commands to inspect forwarding rules: ```gcloud compute forwarding-rules list --regions=eu-west1 --filter='loadBalancingScheme:INTERNAL'``` and drain unhealthy backends: ```gcloud compute backend-services update BACKEND --global --balancing-mode=UTILIZATION --capacity-scaler=0.1```
oncall-anshul: Emma, proceed with the agent toggle. I'll monitor control-plane error rate. If no improvement in 5m, we flip routing fallback.
emma: Rolling flag now -> canary to 5% of private-vpc instances in eu-west1. Canaries running... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

support-jen: Noted — customer-facing support triage: I see 2 tickets from EU customers reporting 502s to internal endpoints. Escalating to account execs.

ops-bot: NimbusOps acknowledged vendor-ticket-553, root cause suspected token refresh storm, vendor working on rate-limiter tuning. ETA unknown.

kyle: Control-plane 5xx rate dropped 45% within 3m of canary config. Nice. I'm seeing route propagation resume for some backends.
oncall-anshul: Good. Continue rollout to 100% for private-vpc eu-west1. Emma, proceed.
emma: Rolled to 100% -> agent upload disabled for scope private-vpc:eu-west1. Monitoring metrics...

kyle: Post-rollout status: control plane 5xxs back down to baseline, forwarding-rule updates succeeding. Customer ticket volume stabilizing.
support-jen: Pushed interim status update to affected customers: "We are investigating a network control-plane disruption impacting cross-region routing for Private VPCs in EU. We've applied a temporary mitigation; some customers may see reduced observability data while we stabilize routing."

simone: Preparing routing fallback plan (manual): set internal flag 'prefer_local_routes=true' and reapply route announcements from us-central to eu-west1 proxies to avoid cross-region control updates. I have the script ready: ```./scripts/force-local-routes.sh --region eu-west1 --sources us-central --dry-run```
oncall-anshul: We won't run the heavy routing fallback unless vendor/GCPSupport says control plane still unstable. Current metrics look stable for next 10m.

ops-bot: GCP Support update: case 130244 — GCP indicates increased rate-limiting on regional control endpoints due to a third-party telemetry surge in EU region; they are applying mitigations on their side.

maria: vendor (NimbusOps) confirms they rolled a throttling patch to their collectors to reduce token refresh frequency. They recommend we re-enable agent uploads slowly and monitor.
kyle: Plan: staged re-enable: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m with observability backoff turned on. I'll own the re-enable and monitors. Postmortem owner: kyle.
oncall-anshul: Handoff to simone for next shift in 20m. Simone, you're now incident owner after handoff. Key items for follow-up: - postmortem - change: add rate-limiter in agent token refresh logic - add control-plane latency alerting per-region - coordinate with NimbusOps for permanent fix
simone: Acked. I'll take ownership. Thanks everyone. I'll also schedule a customer outreach sync with support-jen and account teams.

support-jen: Final note for now: 3 customer incidents correlated, majority recovered after mitigation. Filed follow-ups to inform accounts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring baseline restored). If symptoms return, re-open with command `/incident reopen 2141590000` :white_check_mark:

simone: Marking post-incident actions: 1) postmortem draft (owner: kyle) 2) agent change PR (owner: emma) 3) improve control-plane per-region dashboards (owner: raj) 4) vendor SLA discussion (owner: maria). I'll create tasks after this thread.
kyle: Quick ops note — temp rollback steps and commands saved to runbook: docs/internal/incidents/2141590000-agent-egress-throttle.md (will attach to postmortem).
maria: Closing vendor ticket once NimbusOps confirms stable collector rollout.
simone: Thanks team. Ending thread, will keep watch for the next 30m then close follow-ups. :thumbsup:
